paragraphs.text: Caliman is a large island far to the south in Dominaria . It lies southeast of Jamuraa .
Caliman is the setting for Portal Second Age . Most of the civilized races use both magic and technology. Caliman is the only place on Dominaria where handguns have been invented and are in use.
Alaborn - a highly advanced human kingdom on the southern plains . Trokin - capital of Alaborn
The Talas - a region of islands on the southwest of the main continent, inhabited by dark-skinned humans who ply the seas and skies as merchants, pirates , and wizards .
Norwood - the elven forest that covers much of the north part of the continent.
Dakmor - swampy island north of the mainland. Home of the swamp queen Tojira and her nightstalker minions.
